description_en: Queries the database accounts of a database
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-database-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2za0ro06 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDatabaseAccounts

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the DescribeInstances operation to query the bastion host ID.[](~~153281~~)
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database whose database accounts you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html operation to query the database ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询数据库账户的数据库实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758822.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.
Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Only exact match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的数据库账户名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询
parameters.name: database_account_name

DatabaseAccounts.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户列表

DatabaseAccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

DatabaseSchema.description_en: The name of the database. A value is returned for this parameter if the engine of the database with the specified database ID is PostgreSQL or Oracle
DatabaseSchema.description_zh: 数据库名。当DatabaseId对应的Database为Postgres和Oracle时，DatabaseSchema有返回值

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether the database account has a password. Valid values:

true

false
HasPassword.description_zh:
数据库账户是否设置密码。取值：

true：已设置密码。
false：未设置密码

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of database accounts returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账户总数量
